title: Show HN: Needle: We Distilled Gemini Tool Calling into a 26M Model
summary: Needle is a 26M parameter open-source model specialized in function-calling (tool use), designed to run on consumer devices at impressive speeds (6000 tok/s prefill, 1200 tok/s decode). The project challenges the assumption that tool-calling requires massive models, arguing that function-calling is fundamentally a retrieval-and-assembly task that smaller models can handle efficiently.
problem_solved: Enables lightweight, on-device AI agent capabilities without requiring expensive hardware or cloud services.
why_valuable: Democratizes agentic AI experiences by making tool-calling functionality accessible on budget phones and consumer devices, reducing cost and latency while improving privacy.
